summary: Streaming stops after first chunk on /v1/chat/completions (Globex)
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that when stream=true, they receive the first SSE event and then nothing else. Their code keeps waiting; they never see [DONE].

Impact: Their chat UI shows 19 characters then stops; retry produces a second assistant message.

Environment: Dedicated cluster in eu-west; customer uses redwood-sdk-python 0.9.1 with OpenAI-compatible API.

Notes: Non-streaming works. Streaming works from curl but not from their Python process behind corporate proxy.
comments: Avery Johnson (Support): Customer says  only first chunk then hang. Asking for minimal repro.
Dev Patel (SDK): Looking at python SDK: we buffer until newline boundaries; if proxy coalesces chunks weirdly, it may appear 'stuck'. But they say curl works so might be their proxy + keepalive.
Alex Martinez (Platform): Our SSE events sometimes go quiet while backend is generating. Heartbeat should help. Is eu-west already on the heartbeat build?
Dev Patel (SDK): Suggested workaround: set `REDWOOD_STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT=120` and ensure requests uses `stream=True` w/ iter_lines(decode_unicode=True).
Avery Johnson (Support): After enabling heartbeat build in eu-west and customer proxy exception, issue not reproducible.
resolution: Mitigated by rolling the SSE heartbeat build to eu-west and advising customer to adjust proxy settings / SDK stream read timeout.
